ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text: As shown in the figure, line AB and line CD intersect at point O, and OB bisects $\angle EOD$. If $\angle DOE : \angle EOC = 2 : 3$, find the degree measure of $\angle AOC$.
ready1_open_rewrite.raw_answer_text:
Solution:\\
Since $\angle DOE \colon \angle EOC = 2 \colon 3$\\
Therefore, $\angle DOE = 180^\circ \times \frac{2}{5} = 72^\circ$\\
Since $OB$ bisects $\angle EOD$\\
Therefore, $\angle DOB = \frac{1}{2} \times 72^\circ = 36^\circ$\\
Therefore, $\angle AOC = \angle DOB = \boxed{36^\circ}$.
